<function name="SetDrawLanguageIDAtLeft" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets where to draw the language selection box.

See <page>Panel:SetDrawLanguageID</page> for a function that hides or shows the language selection box.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="left" type="boolean">true = left, false = right</arg>
	</args>
</function>
